critical_code_review_comments: game_studio.PLAYER_REPS declared 16 runtimes but RUNTIMES has 21 — the two dicts should be locked in sync. Consider asserting `set(PLAYER_REPS) == set(RUNTIMES)` at module import (or in a startup health check) so the next runtime addition can't ship half-scaffolded.

GameRuntime.jsx line 126 dispatch map covers all 21 runtimes but is a single dense object literal — as the count grows, extracting the runtime→engine map to a top-level constant (or per-runtime file split) will help maintainability; the file is already 1386 lines.

Roguelike engine re-renders the whole tile grid on each step (tiles detach mid-click loop). Non-blocking for humans but flaky for automated tests — consider incremental DOM updates or exposing player x/y as data attributes on the container for testability.
